# FDE Atlas

> Bilingual (English / Chinese) reference on the forward deployed engineer (FDE) role: explainers, case studies, open FDE jobs and salary data from public job postings, updated every few hours. Chinese pages live under /zh/.

## Topics
- [What Is a Forward Deployed Engineer?](https://fde-atlas.github.io/topics/what-is-a-forward-deployed-engineer/): Definitions, origins and plain-language explainers of the forward deployed engineer role: engineers who embed with customers to ship working software inside their environment.
- [FDE vs Solutions Engineer, SWE and Consultants](https://fde-atlas.github.io/topics/fde-vs-solutions-engineer/): How the forward deployed engineer differs from solutions engineers, sales engineers, solutions architects, product engineers and consultants.
- [Forward Deployed Engineer Salary and Compensation](https://fde-atlas.github.io/topics/forward-deployed-engineer-salary/): What forward deployed engineers earn: base salary ranges, equity, levels and how pay compares with software engineering roles.
- [How to Become a Forward Deployed Engineer: Interviews and Career Path](https://fde-atlas.github.io/topics/how-to-become-a-forward-deployed-engineer/): Interview processes, skills to build, career paths into and out of the role, and first-hand advice from people who have done the job.
- [The Palantir Model: Delta, Echo and the Origins of FDE](https://fde-atlas.github.io/topics/palantir-forward-deployed-model/): Palantir pioneered forward deployed engineering. Its split between Deltas (forward deployed software engineers) and Echos (deployment strategists) still shapes how companies design the role.
- [Why AI Companies Are Betting on Forward Deployed Engineers](https://fde-atlas.github.io/topics/why-ai-companies-hire-fdes/): The business case for forward deployed engineering in the AI era: services versus software margins, moats, deployment companies and the debate over whether the model scales.
- [Building and Managing a Forward Deployed Engineering Team](https://fde-atlas.github.io/topics/building-a-forward-deployed-engineering-team/): Hiring profiles, team structure, managing FDEs, and feeding field learnings back into the product.
- [Forward Deployed Engineers in the Age of AI Agents](https://fde-atlas.github.io/topics/forward-deployed-engineers-ai-agents/): How FDEs deploy LLMs and AI agents in enterprises: evals, RAG, integrations, and getting from demo to production.

## Data and sections
- [Featured reading](https://fde-atlas.github.io/featured/): trending and essential reads, ranked by Hacker News points, citations and source quality
- [Learning path](https://fde-atlas.github.io/learn/): a reading path from understanding the role to landing the job
- [Case studies](https://fde-atlas.github.io/cases/): how Palantir, OpenAI, Ramp and others run forward deployed teams
- [Open-source resources](https://fde-atlas.github.io/open-source/): awesome lists, roadmaps, interview prep and tools on GitHub
- [Analysis and news](https://fde-atlas.github.io/insights/): why the model is spreading and the business-model debate
- [Forward deployed engineer jobs](https://fde-atlas.github.io/jobs/): open FDE roles from public job boards, with location and disclosed pay
- [Forward deployed engineer salary](https://fde-atlas.github.io/salary/): disclosed base pay ranges by company, computed from current job postings
- [Companies hiring forward deployed engineers](https://fde-atlas.github.io/companies/): ranked by open roles, with pay ranges and locations
- [Community discussions](https://fde-atlas.github.io/community/): Hacker News threads and comments about the role
- [Library](https://fde-atlas.github.io/library/): every article in English and Chinese, with summaries and links to the originals
- [About](https://fde-atlas.github.io/about/): where the content comes from and how to request corrections
